rationale: C22 plausibly supplied a concrete drafting template for the child letter. Both transmit draft legislation to Congress, briefly state its substantive purpose, mention an enclosed explanatory letter describing the legislation in detail, note that a corresponding letter was sent to the other chamber's presiding officer, and close by requesting prompt favorable congressional action. The close verbal correspondence and matching sequence go materially beyond routine bill-transmittal boilerplate. C06 and C08 are also similar congressional transmittal letters, but their phrasing and overall sequence match the child less completely.

shared_material.child_excerpt: I am pleased to transmit to the Congress draft legislation implementing the 23d Amendment to the Constitution
shared_material.parent_excerpt: I am transmitting for consideration by the Congress draft legislation to carry out the recommendation in my March ninth message
shared_material.explanation: Both open by transmitting draft legislation to Congress and immediately identify the proposal it implements or carries out.

shared_material.child_excerpt: In addition to the draft bill, I am enclosing a letter from the President of the Board of Commissioners of the District of Columbia describing this legislation in detail.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: In addition to the draft bill, I am enclosing a letter from the Director of the Bureau of the Budget describing the legislation in detail.
shared_material.explanation: This is a highly specific, nearly verbatim sentence with only the originating official changed.

shared_material.child_excerpt: A similar letter has been sent to the Speaker (President of the Senate).
shared_material.parent_excerpt: A letter identical to this one is being sent to the Speaker of the House of Representatives (President of the Senate).
shared_material.explanation: Both include the same chamber-specific parenthetical mechanism for noting the companion letter.

shared_material.child_excerpt: I hope that prompt and favorable action will be taken by the Congress on the proposed legislation
shared_material.parent_excerpt: I hope that prompt action can be scheduled on this important legislation and that the Congress will act favorably on the proposal.
shared_material.explanation: The closing request combines the same distinctive elements—prompt action and favorable congressional treatment—in closely parallel language.
